say:2:1130335002:1.text: To the Grimmaw Clan, battle is like religion. It is all that matters.
say:2:1130335002:1.source_cn: 对我们黑嚎氏族而言，其他事都不重要，只有战斗才是一切。
say:2:1130335002:1.male: To the Grimmaw Clan, battle is like religion. It is all that matters.
say:2:1130335002:1.female: To the Grimmaw Clan, battle is like religion. It is all that matters.

say:3:1130335003:1.text: It's alright, you don't need to console me. Time comes for us all.
say:3:1130335003:1.source_cn: 没关系、没关系，不用安慰我了，时间总是这样的。
say:3:1130335003:1.male: It's alright, you don't need to console me. Time comes for us all.
say:3:1130335003:1.female: It's alright, you don't need to console me. Time comes for us all.
